title: fix(app-shell): eligible approvers count distinct people, not pending_approvers slots (objectui#12781)
body:
Fixes #12781
Clause-②: no (no export, prop or type changes; `DecisionProgressIndicator`'s `eligibleApprovers` prop keeps its type and meaning)

## What changed

`RecordApprovalsPanel` and `ApprovalDecisionPanel` handed `DecisionProgressIndicator` the length of the request's `pending_approvers` list as `eligibleApprovers`. The prop's own doc says "how many approvers may still decide", which counts people. The approvals service keeps one slot per resolved approver entry, so a person holding two of a node's positions fills two slots under the same id and was counted twice.

Both callers now use one module-local helper beside the indicator, `eligibleApproverCount` in `packages/app-shell/src/views/approval-progress/eligibleApprovers.ts`. It counts the distinct addresses in the slate as the server serves it. It resolves nothing and makes no second read: no position, team or group lookup. It is not on the package entry. Unchanged:
- the indicator, and its prop's type and meaning;
- the server tally (`decision_progress.got` / `need`);
- the other `pending_approvers` reads: the record panel's presence check that gates "Waiting on", and the chip list.

## What a slot carries (measured)

Measured live on objectstack `66d456d01`, `examples/app-showcase`, `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`, signed in as the seeded admin, reading `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests/ID`:

| request | `pending_approvers` | `pending_approver_names` | `decision_progress` |
|---|---|---|---|
| High-Value Expense — Committee Quorum | the admin's `sys_user` id, 3 times | one key: Dev Admin | quorum, got 0, need 1 |
| Invoice Dual Sign-off (parallel approval) | the admin's `sys_user` id, 2 times | one key: Dev Admin | unanimous, got 0, need 1 |

Each slot is a bare address string, here a `sys_user` id. A repeated person is the same string served again. The showcase seed puts the admin on `manager`, `finance` and `legal`, and these nodes route to those positions. So distinct strings are the distinct principals, as served.

The spec contract (`ApprovalRequestRow` in `@objectstack/spec/contracts`) also names an email and a `position:NAME` reference as slot addresses. Those are counted as the server left them. An email and a user id for the same person would count as two, because merging them would mean re-deriving the slate in the console.

## Before / after (live, rendered)

The console ran from this worktree (Vite dev, `src` aliases), proxied to that backend, in Chromium at `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`. Each cell is the indicator's header row, read from the DOM:

| surface | request | `main` `33ee9de` | this branch `a42606c` |
|---|---|---|---|
| record page, Approvals tab (`RecordApprovalsPanel`) | Committee Quorum (EXP-DEMO) | Approvals — 0 of 1 · **3 eligible approvers** (one chip: Dev Admin ×3) | Approvals — 0 of 1 · **1 eligible approver** |
| record page, Approvals tab | Invoice Dual Sign-off | Approvals — 0 of 1 · **2 eligible approvers** (one chip: Dev Admin ×2) | Approvals — 0 of 1 · **1 eligible approver** |
| request page (`record:approval_decision`) | Committee Quorum | Approvals — 0 of 1 · **3 eligible approvers** | Approvals — 0 of 1 · **1 eligible approver** |
| request page | Invoice Dual Sign-off | Approvals — 0 of 1 · **2 eligible approvers** | Approvals — 0 of 1 · **1 eligible approver** |

The tally reads `0 of 1` on both sides.

## Pins

The pins sit beside each caller and render under a real i18next instance. Each label is asserted as the pack row (`approvalsInbox.progressEligible`, `approvalsInbox.progressApprovals`) rendered with its count:

- `RecordApprovalsPanel.eligibleApprovers-12781.test.tsx`
- `approval-decision/ApprovalDecisionPanel.eligibleApprovers-12781.test.tsx`

Each file pins four cases:
- one user in two slots among others reads 3, not 4;
- the stock showcase shape (one id in three slots) reads 1, not 3;
- distinct users only read the count the slot length always gave;
- the tally (got 1, need 2) is drawn as served: its row, `aria-valuemax`, `aria-valuenow` and tick count.

`approval-progress/eligibleApprovers.test.ts` pins the helper itself.

## Ablations

Each ablation ran once, through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. The anchor hit went 1 to 0 and the blob changed; the restore was proven (blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):

| ablation | mutation | result (12 tests) |
|---|---|---|
| A1, `main`'s callers | both caller lines put back to the slot-length text | 4 failed, 8 passed. Red: the two duplicate-slot rows in each caller. Green: distinct-only, tally, helper. |
| A2, over-collapse | the helper returns `Math.min(1, distinct)` | 7 failed, 5 passed. Red: distinct-only and the 3-people row in each caller, plus 3 helper tests. Green: the 1-person rows and the tally pins. |
| A3, tally rewrite | both callers hand the indicator `need: eligible` | 2 failed, 10 passed. Red: the tally pin in each caller. |

The tests import the subject by relative path from `src`, so no `dist` sits between a mutation and its run.

## Local gates (at `a42606c`)

- Closure build, `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build` (29 packages): exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0. `--listFilesOnly` shows the test program includes the helper and all three new test files.
- `pnpm exec vitest run` over 20 files: 20 files, 148 tests passed. The set is the 12 tracked tests naming `RecordApprovalsPanel`, `ApprovalDecisionPanel`, `DecisionProgressIndicator` or the helper, plus the 8 console `approvalRequestsDataSource` suites that draw the decision panel on the served request page.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` on the six changed source files: 0 errors and 6 warnings, all on lines this diff does not touch.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: exit 0, 0 new citations.

## Acceptance notes

- **A third copy of the same count, not touched here.** The Approval Center's request drawer (`apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx`, the decision-progress block) computes its own `const eligible = (selected.pending_approvers || []).length` and draws the same `progressEligible` row. On the same backend it still reads "Approvals — 0 of 1 · 3 eligible approvers" for the committee quorum on this branch. It is outside this card's claimed surface, and the dispatch said to report it rather than widen into it. It is reported to the seat.
- The card's title says "5 eligible shown for 3 people", but the QA evidence it cites lists nina, pat, Dev Admin ×2 and lee: 5 slots for 4 people. The defect is the same either way. The live stock reading above is 3 slots for 1 person.
